mapper.select: select count(*) as total_cnt from board A where 1=1
select A.bno ,A.btitle ,DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(A.bcontent, 4000, 1) as bcontent ,A.id ,A.bgroup ,A.bstep ,A.bindent ,A.bhit ,A.bfile ,A.bdate from board A where 1=1 and bno = #{bno}
mapper.update: update board set bhit = bhit+1 where bno = #{bno}
